title: Bring Intent source recovery and late styling cases under 500 ms

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** The maintained held-then-released case rejects a marked target that the reading pane never brings into view. This check covers the initial candidate source opening in that case.

**Story and revision.** SEED-413#speed-intent-source-recovery-and-late-styling-cases at `ab6e9e8931ef39f30e08a4a0fcb83e4b9378abd1`. The fixture selects `real-h264-codec-roundtrip` in `tests/test_clip_core.py` at line 44.

**Fault and observation.** In an isolated detached worktree, I suppressed `targetRef.current?.scrollIntoView` in `dashboard/src/SourceLines.tsx` while leaving the target marker, fixture, and tests intact. A scratch browser `IntersectionObserver`, independent of the replacement matcher, observed line 44 with `aria-current="location"`, intersection ratio 0, and top 1111.61 px. The reading pane ended at 600 px and its scroll offset was 0. The maintained `openClipSource` call to `targets(44)` reached `showsLine` in `intent-file-reading-page.ts:53`. Its viewport poll received false and failed after the data-line assertion passed.

**Runs and restoration.** The same command selected the held-then-released case in each run.

```sh
caffeinate -s -i env -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR npx vitest run --config dashboard/frontend.vitest.config.mts dashboard/frontend-tests/intent/intent-source-target-recovery.spec.ts --testNamePattern 'held then released' --silent=false
```

The baseline passed, the faulted case failed at the viewport assertion, and the restored case passed. One other case was filtered in each run. I verified the restored revision and clean Git status against the initial record, preserved the patch, logs, and failure screenshots at `/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-413-recovery.2QTJBe/evidence`, and removed the scratch worktree.

**Next proof action.** Keep the existing assertion. Slice 4 had already shown that the original and replacement matchers reject a line clipped by the reading pane. This check separately establishes that the maintained case catches the missing production scroll on its initial opening path.

- **Test runtime.** 6.46 s total (measured by Vitest across the baseline 1.70 s, faulted 3.12 s, and restored 1.64 s runs).
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No separate human time measurement was recorded.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable. Active agent time was not measured separately from command time.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 112389 ms (measured), from 1795252094191 to 1795252206580 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

Wrap-up disposition — `ab6e9e8931ef39f30e08a4a0fcb83e4b9378abd1`, Caught, no follow-up.
